description: Cancels a running import (message history or a spreadsheet), as Cancel in the import drawer does; what it already brought in stays. job_id comes from start_history_import or the import list. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: cancel_import
title: Cancel a running import
